title: BTC/USDT Volume Profile vp-v1: independent earlier-market-regime robustness test (2017-09 .. 2018-12)
label: INDEPENDENT EARLIER-MARKET-REGIME ROBUSTNESS TEST - not chronological forward validation (the period predates the 2019-2026 research data)
status: Research only; no orders (live, demo or testnet). Results may NOT be used for parameter optimization.

frozen_from.rule: per variant, the parameters most often selected in the BTC 2024-06..2026-05 walk-forward (protocol frozen_from_dev)

dev_outcome_context: No variant met the development rules (none was a dev candidate). Pre-declared consequence: whatever this test shows, no BTC Volume Profile variant is proposed for a shadow test from this research; a pass would only motivate a NEW, separately pre-registered prospective test on future data.

data.source: data.binance.vision monthly aggTrades and 1m klines, BTCUSDT spot (public, no credentials)
data.note: Binance BTCUSDT trading began 2017-08-17; no data from this period has been used anywhere in this project.

data_quality_rules: every archive matches Binance's published SHA-256 .CHECKSUM
aggregate ids and underlying trade-id ranges contiguous; exact re-sent rows dropped (first copy kept) and counted; any true id gap reported
timestamps non-decreasing; no invalid price/quantity rows
per-minute aggTrades volume equals official 1m kline volume (tolerance 1e-6 relative) on >= 99.9% of minutes, OHLC compared
no-trade gaps > 5 minutes listed as possible exchange outages; never filled
profile periods below 90% 15-minute-bucket coverage are dropped (protocol)
if a rule fails, the test is reported as data-invalid for the affected span rather than repaired with invented data

methodology.costs: base 0.10% taker fee/side + 0.01 spread + 2 USDT slippage; stress 1 bp spread + 10 USDT slippage; low_fee 0.075%
methodology.instrument_filters: current Binance exchangeInfo snapshot (2017 filters differed; documented limitation)

success_criteria_per_variant: mean R > 0 with bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
mean R beats >= 18 of 20 matched random seeds
forbidden: changing parameters, grid, costs or rules after seeing any 2017-2018 data
